###Question 1: Do not log, it is a level-level and report in units not %.
```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/bikeshare (3).csv")
str(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
summary(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
df$weathersit <- factor(df$weathersit)
levels(df$weathersit)
fit <- lm(cnt ~ weathersit + temp + hum + windspeed, data = df)
summary(fit)

beta_temp <- coef(fit)["temp"]
degC_per_unit <- 41
delta_temp_norm <- 10 / degC_per_unit

change_per_10C <- as.numeric(beta_temp * delta_temp_norm)
answer_1_decimal <- round(change_per_10C, 1)

beta_temp
delta_temp_norm
change_per_10C
answer_1_decimal
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/bikeshare (3).csv")
str(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
summary(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
df$weathersit <- factor(df$weathersit)
levels(df$weathersit)
fit <- lm(cnt ~ weathersit * (temp + hum + windspeed), data = df)
summary(fit)

coefs <- coef(fit)

beta_temp_clear <- coefs[["temp"]]
beta_temp_ws2_inter <- unname(coefs[grep("weathersit2:temp|temp:weathersit2", names(coefs))])
beta_temp_cloudy <- beta_temp_clear + beta_temp_ws2_inter
delta_temp_norm <- 10 / 41
change_per_10C_cloudy <- as.numeric(beta_temp_cloudy * delta_temp_norm)
answer_3dp <- round(change_per_10C_cloudy, 3)

beta_temp_clear
beta_temp_ws2_inter
beta_temp_cloudy
answer_3dp
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/bikeshare (3).csv")
str(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
summary(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
df$weathersit <- factor(df$weathersit)
levels(df$weathersit)
df$log_cnt <- log(df$cnt)
summary(df$log_cnt)
fit <- lm(log_cnt ~ weathersit * (temp + hum + windspeed), data = df)
summary(fit)

b_temp_clear <- coef(fit)["temp"]
delta_temp_norm <- 10 / 41
mult_effect_clear <- exp(b_temp_clear * delta_temp_norm)
answer_4dp <- round(mult_effect_clear, 4)

b_temp_clear
delta_temp_norm
answer_4dp
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/bikeshare (3).csv")
str(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
summary(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed","cnt")])
df$weathersit <- factor(df$weathersit)
levels(df$weathersit)
fit <- lm(cnt ~ weathersit * (temp + hum + windspeed), data = df)
summary(fit)

temp_norm <- 25/41
hum_norm  <- 0.5
wind_norm <- 5/67
new <- data.frame(
  weathersit = factor("1", levels = levels(df$weathersit)),
  temp = temp_norm,
  hum = hum_norm,
  windspeed = wind_norm
)
new
pred_cnt <- predict(fit, new)
answer_3dp <- round(pred_cnt, 3)
pred_cnt
answer_3dp
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/bikeshare (3).csv")
str(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
summary(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed","cnt")])
df$weathersit <- factor(df$weathersit)
levels(df$weathersit)
df$log_cnt <- log(df$cnt)
summary(df$log_cnt)
fit <- lm(log_cnt ~ weathersit * (temp + hum + windspeed), data = df)
summary(fit)

temp_norm <- 25/41
hum_norm  <- 0.5
wind_norm <- 5/67
new <- data.frame(
  weathersit = factor("1", levels = levels(df$weathersit)),  # Clear
  temp = temp_norm,
  hum = hum_norm,
  windspeed = wind_norm
)
new

log_hat <- predict(fit, new)
cnt_hat <- exp(log_hat)
answer_3dp <- round(cnt_hat, 3)

log_hat
cnt_hat
answer_3dp
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/Downloads/bikeshare (3).csv")
str(df[, c("cnt","weathersit","temp","hum","windspeed")])
df$busy <- as.integer(df$cnt > 7000)
df$weathersit <- factor(df$weathersit)
levels(df$weathersit)
fit <- glm(busy ~ weathersit * (temp + hum + windspeed),
           data = df, family = binomial)
summary(fit)

b_temp_clear <- coef(fit)["temp"]
delta_temp_norm <- 10/41
odds_ratio <- exp(b_temp_clear * delta_temp_norm)
answer_2dp <- round(odds_ratio, 2)
b_temp_clear
delta_temp_norm
answer_2dp
```
